select
vvs_parent,org_einheit,'VVS '||vvs||' '||org_ltext
from
(
select
distinct *
from
(SELECT
distinct
case 
  when substr(vvs,1,2) in ('10','13','14','15','16','17','18')
       or substr(vvs,1,4) in ('2203')
  then 'A_'||substr(vvs,1,4)||'00'
  else 'A_ZU_KLAEREN'
  end VVS_Parent,
'A_'||nvl(VVS,'NA') org_einheit,
vvs
FROM
dtl_vr_auszahlungen
WHERE
stichtag=(select stichtag from vr_parameter)

union all

select distinct
case 
  when substr(vvs,1,2) in ('10','13','14','15','16','17','18')
       or substr(vvs,1,4) in ('2203')
  then 'A_'||substr(vvs,1,4)||'00'
  else 'A_ZU_KLAEREN'
  end VVS_Parent,
'A_'||nvl(vvs,'NA'),
vvs
from 
dtl_vr_neue_vertraege
where stichtag=(select stichtag from vr_parameter)

union all

select distinct
case 
  when substr(vvs,1,2) in ('10','13','14','15','16','17','18')
       or substr(vvs,1,4) in ('2203')
  then 'A_'||substr(vvs,1,4)||'00'
  else 'A_ZU_KLAEREN'
  end VVS_Parent,
'A_'||nvl(vvs,'NA'),
vvs
from 
dtl_vr_bestandszusagen
where stichtag=(select stichtag from vr_parameter)

union all

select distinct
case 
  when substr(vvs,1,2) in ('10','13','14','15','16','17','18')
       or substr(vvs,1,4) in ('2203')
  then 'A_'||substr(vvs,1,4)||'00'
  else 'A_ZU_KLAEREN'
  end VVS_Parent,
'A_'||nvl(vvs,'NA'),
vvs
from 
dtl_vr_revo_auszahlungen
where stichtag=(select stichtag from vr_parameter)

union all

select distinct
case 
  when substr(vvs,1,2) in ('10','13','14','15','16','17','18')
       or substr(vvs,1,4) in ('2203')
  then 'A_'||substr(vvs,1,4)||'00'
  else 'A_ZU_KLAEREN'
  end VVS_Parent,
'A_'||nvl(vvs,'NA'),
vvs
from 
dtl_vr_entscheidungsvorlagen
where stichtag=(select stichtag from vr_parameter)
and bearb_dat >= to_date('01.04.2011','DD.MM.YYYY')
)
order by 1,2) a
,
(select org_ktext, org_ltext from org_historien@dws1 where vt_dat=to_date('4000-12-31','YYYY-MM-DD')  and trim(TRANSLATE(org_ktext, '0123456789-,.', ' ')) is null and org_ktext is not null ) b

where a.vvs=b.org_ktext
